obj.jelajahi: Jelajahi rumah. Cari makanan dan petunjuk
obj.laci: Cari tanggal penting, lalu buka laci kamar Abang

kulkas.1: Kulkas hanya berisi air dan sebotol kecap hampir habis.
kulkas.2: Bang Dimas makan apa selama ini?

foto.1: Foto keluarga di atas lemari, berdebu.
foto.3: Kita berempat. Sekarang tinggal berdua di rumah ini.

amplop.1: Tumpukan amplop di meja. Tagihan, semua belum dibuka.
amplop.2: Abang tidak bilang apa-apa waktu kita ngobrol minggu lalu.

radio.1: Berita siang: warga diminta waspada api di musim kemarau.
radio.2: Belum musimnya, tapi sudah ada yang nyala.

kamar.1: Kamar Abang berantakan. Baju menumpuk di sudut.
kamar.2: Tercium bau rokok, keringat, dan tanah. Campur jadi satu.
kamar.3: Meja kecil di pojok. Lacinya terkunci.

kalender.2: Tanggal 17 dibulati tinta merah. Di bawahnya ditulis: Ayah dan Ibu.
kalender.3: Hari ini bukan tanggal segitu. Kenapa dibulat?

kunci.1: Itu meja di kamar Abang. Masuk kamar dulu.

kwitansi.1: Laci terbuka. Di dalamnya ada kertas dilipat rapi.
kwitansi.2: Kwitansi pinjol. Nama Abang. Angkanya banyak sekali.

foto.1: Kufoto dulu, biar tidak ada yang hilang. Kutaruh lagi seperti semula.

keluar.1: Sudah gelap di luar. Rumah terasa lebih besar saat sepi.

pergi.1: Kunci pintunya. Nanti Abang pulang, dia yang buka.

tunggu.1: Masih ada yang belum kubuka. Lacinya belum selesai.

obj.jelajahi: Explore the house. Look for food and clues
obj.laci: Find the important date, then open Bang's drawer
obj.kwitansi: Check what is inside the drawer
obj.keluar: Done. Leave the house before dark

p1.title: Locked Drawer
p1.desc: Four digits from an important date.
p1.hint2: The date in the corner of the family photo

kulkas.1: The fridge holds only water and one bottle of soy sauce almost empty.
kulkas.2: What has Bang Dimas been eating all this time?

foto.1: A family photo on top of the cupboard, dusty.
foto.2: Raka wipes it with his sleeve.
foto.3: There were four of us. Now only two of us in this house.
foto.4: The date stamp in the corner of the photo: 17 09.

amplop.1: A stack of envelopes on the table. Bills, none of them open.
amplop.2: Bang said nothing when we talked last week.
amplop.3: Raka lines them up neatly again.

radio.1: Midday news: villagers are asked to watch for fire in the dry season.
radio.2: The season is not here yet, but something is already burning.
radio.3: The radio is turned off again.

kamar.1: Bang's room is a mess. Clothes pile in the corner.
kamar.2: A smell of smoke, sweat, and soil. All mixed into one.
kamar.3: A small desk in the corner. The drawer is locked.

kalender.2: The 17th is circled in red ink. Under it is written: Father and Mother.
kalender.3: Today is not that date. Why circle it?

kunci.1: That is Bang's desk. Get into the room first.

kwitansi.1: The drawer opens. Inside is a neatly folded paper.
kwitansi.2: A loan receipt. Bang's name. The number is very large.
kwitansi.3: Raka holds the paper for a moment.
kwitansi.cA: Keep the receipt in the bag
kwitansi.cB: Photograph it, then put it back

simpan.1: I will take it for now. It may be needed.

foto.1: A photo first, so nothing is lost. Then back in its place.

keluar.1: It is dark outside. The house feels bigger when it is empty.

pergi.1: Lock the door. When Bang comes home, he opens it.

tunggu.1: There is still something I have not opened. The drawer is not done.
